_comment: Pilot definitions. Coordinates are the *requested* points; POWER values apply to the 0.5x0.625 deg (meteorology) and 1x1 deg (solar) cells containing them.

pilots.label: Rajshahi (Barind Tract, Rajshahi Division, Bangladesh)
pilots.why_this_range: 1991-2020 is the WMO standard climate normal period; 2021-2025 adds recent seasons. Gives >30 seasons for reliability statistics.

pilots.label: Story County near Ames, Iowa, USA
pilots.why_this_range: Same as BD pilot for comparability. Independent US references (PRISM, CDL, SSURGO, NASS) must be supplied from USDA/OSU, not POWER.
pilots.role: secondary US research pilot (candidate corn/soy/cover crops)
